evidence.summary: An employee submits a claim; Accounts Payable checks receipts and returns incomplete claims; manager and threshold-based controller approval precede payment; Accounts Payable informs the employee of payment or rejection.

The employee corrects an incomplete pack under the same claim identity; the manager decides business purpose; controller approval applies above EUR 2,000; approval order is not prescribed; payment waits for every required approval.

Accounts Payable checks receipts, correction may repeat under the same claim identity, manager approval is mandatory, claims above EUR 2,000 require controller approval without a prescribed order, and Accounts Payable records payment or rejection and sends the matching notice.
Finance-controller approval applies at EUR 2,500 or more, and the complementary route is below EUR 2,500; unrelated work and identities must remain unchanged.

decisions.description: Model the manager review and the controller-threshold route as parallel work because the sources require both when applicable and explicitly prescribe no order.
Do not invent an escalation or disagreement-resolution path because the sources identify neither an escalation approver nor an external recipient.
Replace the controller threshold with EUR 2,500 or more and the complementary route with below EUR 2,500 while preserving every unrelated element identity and behavior.

issues.description: The sources do not identify who resolves a disagreement about business purpose; that unsupported exception is omitted from this process scope.

links.assertion: The employee submits the claim and receipt images.
Accounts Payable checks that required receipts are present.
An incomplete claim is returned for correction.
The employee corrects the same claim rather than creating a new identity.
A corrected claim may be checked again.
The line manager decides whether the expense had a business purpose.
No order is prescribed between manager and controller approvals.
Controller approval is required when the claim amount is EUR 2,500 or more.
The complementary route covers claim amounts below EUR 2,500.
The Finance Controller supplies the additional approval when the threshold is met.
Payment occurs only after every required approval is present.
Accounts Payable records payment for an approved claim.
Accounts Payable records rejection when required approval is absent.
Accounts Payable sends the employee a payment notice.
Accounts Payable sends the employee a rejection notice.
